Payroll is not complete until it agrees with the general ledger.

A practical payroll-to-general-ledger reconciliation covering gross pay, taxes, deductions, liabilities and cash.

Payroll reports, bank withdrawals and general-ledger entries should tell the same story. Differences commonly arise from mapping changes, off-cycle payrolls, voids, benefit deductions or tax payments recorded to the wrong account.

Monthly reconciliation points

  • Gross wages by payroll register and GL account
  • Employer payroll taxes and benefit expense
  • Employee withholdings and deductions
  • Payroll clearing and liability balances
  • Tax-agency and benefit-provider payments
  • Payroll cash withdrawals and returned items

Document unresolved differences with an owner, cause, amount and expected resolution date rather than carrying unexplained balances forward.
